import importlib.util, numpy as np, time
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('qwen_claude_field_theory/closure_2026/g03r_converged_collapse_adaptive_shells.py')
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g03r_review',p); g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(g)
t=time.monotonic()
ref=g.run('cluster',1e30,N=800,newton=True,cs_fixed=0.0)
print('Cold N800:',{'fractions':ref['frac'].tolist(),'Macc_shares':ref['Macc']/ref['Mshare'],'rta_Mpc':ref['r_ta']/g.Mpc,'slope':g.slope(ref['prof'],ref['r_ta'])},flush=True)
a=g.atmosphere('cluster',3e5,ref['Macc'],ref['r_ta'],ngrid=400)
b=g.atmosphere('cluster',3e5,ref['Macc'],ref['r_ta'],ngrid=1600)
diff=[abs(g.M_at(a,R)/g.M_at(b,R)-1) for R in (g.Mpc,.2*g.Mpc)]
print('Existing H1 atmosphere refinement:',diff,'PASS=',max(diff)<.01,flush=True)
Mb1=g.SYSTEMS['cluster']['Mb0']/(1+.5**3); Mb=g.baryon_M(g.XCOP_R,Mb1,'cluster'); yb=g.G*Mb/g.XCOP_R**2/g.A0['canonical']
data_slope=np.polyfit(np.log10(g.XCOP_R/g.kpc),np.log10(g.XCOP_ETA-1),1)[0]
best=None
for K in np.geomspace(5e4,1e6,14):
    a=g.atmosphere('cluster',K,ref['Macc'],ref['r_ta'])
    Md=np.interp(g.XCOP_R,a['r'],a['Md'])
    eta=(Mb+Md)*g.nu_tot(g.G*(Mb+Md)/g.XCOP_R**2/g.A0['canonical'])/(g.nu_tot(yb)*Mb)
    supplied=(eta-1)/(g.XCOP_ETA-1)
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(np.log10(np.maximum(supplied,1e-6))**2))
    trend=np.polyfit(np.log10(g.XCOP_R/g.kpc),np.log10(np.maximum(eta-1,1e-6)),1)[0]
    if best is None or rms<best[1]: best=(K,rms,trend)
passed=best[1]<.15 and abs(best[2]-data_slope)<.2
print('Existing X1 Newtonian branch:',best,'data slope',data_slope,'PASS=',passed,flush=True)
print('Runtime seconds:',round(time.monotonic()-t,3),'No files written.',flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if max(diff)<.01 and passed else 1)
